newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan car shares up in morning, helped by weak yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan car shares up in morning, helped by weak yen.

text.p: Shares in Japanese car makers rose in Thursday's morning session as the yen's weakness against the dollar gave investors psychological support to buy back the shares which had been sold lately, brokers said.
By the midday close, shares of Toyota Motor Corp had risen 10 yen to 2,700 with a volume of 2.27 million shares, the third most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Honda Motor Corp was up 20 yen at 2,690 yen with 1.93 million shares traded, ranking fifth heftiest in volume.
The yen briefly fell to 113 against the dollar in early trade.
